info.name: KETARI JOB BOARD & RECRUITMENT PLATFORM API
info.description:
# Ketari Job Board & Recruitment Platform API Collection

Production-quality Postman collection covering all backend REST endpoints for the **Ketari Platform**:
- **00 - Health & Documentation**: System readiness, MySQL connectivity, and OpenAPI 3.0 specification
- **01 - Authentication & Identity**: Registration, login, stateless JJWT refresh, and identity inspection
- **02 - Public Job Discovery**: Multi-criteria search (keyword, location, workplace, employment type, salary, skills), pagination, and detail inspection
- **03 - Job Seeker Profile**: Personal bio, skills, education, contact info, and profile avatar upload
- **04 - Resumes & CVs**: Document upload (PDF/DOCX, max 5MB), metadata inspection, binary download, and deletion
- **05 - Employer Profile & Branding**: Company profile management, industry, website, and logo upload
- **06 - Employer Job Management**: Posting vacancies, updates, listings, and deletion (enforces admin approval vetting)
- **07 - Saved Jobs (Bookmarks)**: Candidate job bookmarking, listing, status check, and deletion
- **08 - Applications (Candidate)**: Job application submission with resume and cover letter, status audit trail
- **09 - Employer Application Review**: Employer candidate screening, stage progression (SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW -> SHORTLISTED -> INTERVIEW -> ACCEPTED / REJECTED)
- **10 - User Notifications**: System notifications, unread counters, mark single as read, and bulk mark all read
- **11 - Administrator Governance**: Operational stats, pending employer vetting, approving/rejecting employers, and content moderation
- **12 - Security & RBAC Enforcement**: Negative testing for 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 400 Validation, and 409 Conflict
- **13 - Full End-to-End Hiring Lifecycle**: 18-step end-to-end flow from employer vetting to application acceptance

### Authentication Roles
1. `EMPLOYEE`: Job seekers searching jobs, uploading resumes, bookmarking, and applying.
2. `EMPLOYER`: Companies posting vacancies, uploading logos, and reviewing applicants.
3. `ADMIN`: Platform operators vetting employers, monitoring metrics, and moderating listings.

### Standard API Response Wrapper
All successful responses return unified JSON matching `ApiResponse<T>`:
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-07T14:30:00Z",
  "status": 200,
  "message": "Job retrieved successfully",
  "data": { ... },
  "correlationId": "c0a80101-..."
}
```

item.name: 02 - Public Job Discovery
item.description: Public search, multi-criteria filtering, categories discovery, and individual job viewing.

request.description:
Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public
Retrieves paginated active jobs ordered by postedDate descending.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public?keyword=Engineer
Filters jobs matching keyword in title or description.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public?workplaceType=REMOTE
Filters jobs by REMOTE, HYBRID, or ON_SITE workplace.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public?employmentType=FULL_TIME
Filters jobs by FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT, INTERNSHIP, or TEMPORARY.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public?category=Engineering&location=Addis Ababa
Demonstrates multi-attribute dynamic query specification.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public/categories
Returns distinct categories from active job listings.

Endpoint: GET /api/jobs/public/{id}
Retrieves full job details including required skills, deadline, and employer info.

item.name: 13 - Full End-to-End Hiring Lifecycle
item.description: Complete sequential workflow from admin vetting and job posting to candidate application, status audit trail, and offer acceptance.

item.name: L-01: Admin Logs In & Checks Dashboard

request.description: Lifecycle Step 01: Administrator authenticates and captures lifecycle_admin_token.
Lifecycle Step 02: Employer registers. Account created with isApproved=false.

item.name: L-03: Verify Unapproved Employer Cannot Login

request.description: Lifecycle Step 03: Proves unapproved employer is blocked from logging in until vetted.
Lifecycle Step 04: Administrator approves employer registration.
Lifecycle Step 05: Approved employer logs in successfully.
Lifecycle Step 06: Employer completes company profile.
